method: nearest BAY,COVE,INLT,CST,GULF,STRT and Japanese sea-channel name suido/seto within10km; selected major island reference within20km fallback; competing feature points <1km difference unassigned; obvious inland source labels unassigned. Distances are map-reference distances, never positional-accuracy or area-membership claims. Names are English transliterations from GeoNames asciiname. Source-alias matches of the same feature type within 20 km are grouped once; this is a reference-label grouping, not a complete inventory of disjoint named bays. Inland exclusions and ambiguous positions remain unassigned. Each coordinate receives at most one group.
review: Distances, source aliases, all 96 proposed associations and exclusion reasons reviewed; reference-point proximity only, no map-boundary validation.
